modules.name: Web Panel
modules.description: A web panel that lets Raghuvir record, check and close society complaints and services across all projects.

modules.name: Role-based Mobile App
modules.description: A role-based mobile app for Android and iOS that lets Raghuvir and its residents record, check and close society complaints and services.

requirements.title: Record, check and close every society complaint and service
requirements.description: The web panel and mobile app must let Raghuvir and its residents record, check and close every society complaint and service across all projects.

requirements.title: Provide one web panel
requirements.description: The system must include one web panel for managing society complaints and services.

requirements.title: Provide one role-based mobile app for Android and iOS
requirements.description: The system must include one role-based mobile app that runs on Android and iOS.
